scope: Complete frozen current-item and available immutable-version inventory; no protected prompts, answers, options, titles, distractor definitions or actor identities

profiles.scenarioProfile: Critique a verbal representation that combines incompatible model commitments; no apparatus, compression sequence or observed intervention is supplied.
profiles.responseDemand: Choose among four proposed corrections to the represented model.
profiles.solutionInferenceProfile: Check all parts of the representation against the same taught model, then judge each proposed correction for internal consistency. This differs from predicting the effect of a named intervention. The correct correction and option are restricted.

nearestComparisons.sharedDemand: Same taught model and related misconceptions.
nearestComparisons.difference: The existing items use intervention/effect explanation; this candidate makes consistency of the complete representation the response demand. The shared concept remains residual overlap.

nearestComparisons.reference: S02 T02/T03 published guides, runtime v2
nearestComparisons.sharedDemand: The guides teach model distinctions and use model tokens.
nearestComparisons.difference: The accepted candidate does not repeat a guide token-count or token-motion exercise. Teaching exposure still limits any claim of independent evidence.
No body-versus-material identification pair is reused.

profiles.disposition: new reasoning coverage candidate; accepted for draft only
profiles.source: Physics 7, Melikyan/Mailyan, 2023, Chapter II section 7, printed pp.25–26 / PDF pp.26–27; programme Topic 2 mandatory outcome 1(1).
profiles.sourceRationale: An authored critique of a representation using the taught qualitative model; no new experiment, advanced theory or quantitative law. Supports model understanding, not the entire experimental-justification outcome.
profiles.illustrationDecision: Verbal task fully specifies the representation. Existing source figures do not depict the disputed representation, and a decorative model image would add no evidence. No image attached.
profiles.protectedFinding: Related practice and guide concepts overlap; the additional consistency demand is provisional, requiring human judgment. Do not count this alone as full diagnostic outcome coverage. Separate experimental-evidence partner remains missing.
profiles.distractorReview: Three distinct candidate errors reviewed for mapping scope. Two narrowly scoped draft definitions plus one existing active definition; no definition activation. Correct response is not mapped.
profiles.comparisonWithinBatch: Model-consistency critique differs from the other candidate’s interpretation of an incomplete experimental record.

profiles.scenarioProfile: Interpret a qualitative experimental record with an explicitly movable boundary and an omitted intervention; retained sample conditions are stated.
profiles.responseDemand: Evaluate options combining a model interpretation with a claim about the intervention.
profiles.solutionInferenceProfile: Evaluate both clauses together: apply the taught model to the recorded effect, then assess whether the record warrants the proposed causal inference. The accepted model change, causal conclusion and correct option are restricted.

nearestComparisons.difference: Their intervention is specified. The candidate adds appraisal of a causal claim made from an incomplete record.
No compression/reversal sequence or open-versus-closed comparison is reused.

nearestComparisons.reference: PHY7-U02-S02-I10 superseded v1 and current v4
nearestComparisons.sharedDemand: v1 combines known forward explanations; v4 limits a stronger unsupported conclusion.
nearestComparisons.difference: The candidate combines one event’s model interpretation with evaluation of a causal claim; it does not repeat two supplied forward mechanisms or request a numerical conclusion.

nearestComparisons.reference: S02 T03 guide runtime v2; PHY7-U01-S05-I05 v1, protected mastery
nearestComparisons.sharedDemand: Match the strength of a conclusion to available evidence.
nearestComparisons.difference: The candidate combines an S02 model judgment with causal inference, rather than the protected comparator’s generalization demand. Similar epistemic caution remains a material residual overlap.

profiles.disposition: new reasoning coverage candidate; accepted for draft only
profiles.source: Physics 7, Melikyan/Mailyan, 2023, Chapter II section 7, printed pp.24–25 / PDF pp.25–26; programme Topic 2 mandatory outcome 1(1).
profiles.sourceRationale: Authored incomplete-record application within taught qualitative changes. The movable boundary makes the premises physically coherent. No gas law, numerical pressure relationship or unstated fixed-volume assumption is introduced.
profiles.illustrationDecision: An intervention-revealing source picture would change the evidence supplied. A neutral sketch adds no necessary information after the movable-boundary premise is explicit. No image attached.
profiles.protectedFinding: Reserve from practice/diagnostic delivery. Residual overlap with I10, T03 and the protected Chapter I comparator requires human protected-use judgment; no empirical difficulty or parallel-form equivalence claim.
profiles.distractorReview: Two conceptually separate candidate errors use two new draft definitions. One response maps to both, the other wrong responses each to the relevant one; no incorrect heating-specific or numeric-model definition is used merely to pass QA.
profiles.comparisonWithinBatch: Compound model/evidence appraisal differs from the other candidate’s consistency-only critique.
